reports.basis.booking_help: Booking date: each reservation counts on the day it was booked, with all its nights and its whole value, whenever the stay takes place, unless stay dates are also set: then only its nights inside them count, with their shares.
reports.basis.stay_help: Stay date: only the nights inside the period count. Each stay's amounts are split over its nights in whole cents (equal shares, the remainder on the last night, as the folio bills them). Example: a 4-night stay with 2 nights inside the period counts 2 room nights and those 2 nights' shares.
reports.cancellation.empty: No booked stays match these filters
reports.cancellation.help: Every booked stay of the selection counts whole, cancelled or not. Cancelled figures include no-shows; fees are what the cancellation policy kept.
reports.chart.summary: Bar chart of {metric} by {dim}, {count} bars. The table below lists every value.
reports.chart.table_hint: Exact figures for every row are in the table below.
reports.conversion.empty: No booking-engine sessions in this period
reports.conversion.help: Booking-engine sessions that started on the sale dates (kept for 180 days), each counted once: searched, quoted, guest details, booked (a booking was made) and confirmed; a later step counts the earlier ones too. Conversion % = booked ÷ searched.
reports.cost_visible: Cost and margin are shown because you may view contract costs.
reports.empty_hint: Try a longer period, the other date basis or include cancelled reservations.
reports.err.dates: Choose a start and an end date.
reports.err.order: The end date is before the start date.
reports.err.too_long: Please choose a range of at most {max} days.
reports.extras.empty: No extras were sold with these stays
reports.extras.help: Extras sold with the selected stays, including those added later, at the price sold (before booking-level coupons). Each stay counts whole.

reports.filter.options_cut.one: Only the first {count} room type or rate plan is listed.
reports.filter.options_cut.other: Only the first {count} room types and rate plans are listed.

reports.margin.help: Contract vs selling, per stay priced from a contract: revenue = accommodation + extras + taxes added on top (the reservation's own); contract cost + margin = accommodation; margin % = margin ÷ accommodation. Stays without a contract cost are shown beside it; a cancelled stay counts only the fee it kept. Amounts in different currencies are never added.
reports.no_access: Commercial reports need the “View commercial reports” permission at this hotel.
reports.pace.chart_hint: Room nights already booked for the stay window, as they stood on each date.
reports.pace.empty: Nothing is on the books for this stay window yet
reports.pace.help: Each bar shows how many room nights for stays in the window were already booked on that date. The growth from one bar to the next is the pick-up. Cancelled reservations drop out from the day they were cancelled.
reports.pace.summary: Column chart of room nights on the books for stays from {from} to {to}, as of 90, 60, 30, 14 and 7 days ago and today ({today} today). The table below lists every value.
reports.pace.table_caption: Room nights on the books by snapshot date
reports.payment.help: The bookings of the selected stays: their value (cancellation fees included), what has been paid and the balance (value − paid). Payments by method below.
reports.payment.methods_help: Succeeded charges and refunds of these bookings, per method and currency.
reports.per_currency_notice: Totals are shown per currency. Amounts in different currencies are never added together.
reports.production.table_caption: Production grouped by {dim}. Column headers sort the table.
reports.promotion.empty: No promotion was applied to these stays
reports.promotion.help: Each stay counts whole. A stay with two promotions counts under both; the total adds up the discounts given. Offers on the contract cost are listed only with access to contract costs.

reports.truncated.one: {count} more row is added up in the last row.
reports.truncated.other: {count} more rows are added up in the last row.
